title: Trust, Layered: Warranted AI Knowledge Extraction for Interpretive Corpora, Demonstrated on Jung's Collected Works (dataset, pipeline, and paper)
description: A warranted atlas of C. G. Jung's Collected Works, graph v2.4.0: 1244 nodes, 5132 edges, 6887 references over eleven volumes. Each reference is anchored to a numbered paragraph with a verbatim quote of at most 25 words, gated by a model of a different family from the proposer, and cross-vendor audited (98.5% of references). A normalization layer (260 relations) and a relation-family layer (ruleset v0.7.2, calibration record pipeline/family_calibration/records/2026-08-13_v072_run4.json, PASS) inherit no warrant from the claim beneath. Every claim carries a warrant profile: the checks it survived, who made them, and which nobody has made. v2.4.0 mines CW 12, Psychology and Alchemy, CW 13, Alchemical Studies, and CW 14, Mysterium Coniunctionis, a second time, under the form rule and the reporting clause, with a cap of 9% quoted words per volume; it adds a page on Jung's reading of the ten woodcuts of the Rosarium philosophorum, shown from his own copy as digitised by e-rara.ch (Public Domain Mark). v2.3.0 added CW 16 and CW 7, mined end to end, CW 6 chapters X and XI, and the RDF export (graph, ontology and VoID as Turtle, no quotations) under exports/rdf/. Includes the full transaction ledger, all experiment inputs, verdicts and adjudications (E0-E10, Studies B and C), the family calibration records, and the James pilot. The paper, Trust, Layered, stays as published with v2.0.0 and describes that release: 589 nodes, 2091 edges, 2678 references. Graph v2.4.0 · ruleset v0.7.2 · calibration record 2026-08-13_v072_run4 (PASS). Succeeds v2.3.0. Copyrighted source texts are not included. Quotations are at most 25 words, under quotation exceptions (see docs/LEGAL.md). The code is MIT and the dataset's original structure and metadata are CC BY 4.0. Both licences exclude the verbatim quotations, which remain with their rights holders (see NOTICE). Live atlas: https://symbolicworld.observer
